blocks.content: The Constitution is not a mere lawyers' document, it is a vehicle of Life, and its spirit is always the spirit of Age.

items: Article 32 is known as the 'Heart and Soul of the Constitution' as designated by Dr. B.R. Ambedkar.
The 42nd Constitutional Amendment Act of 1976 added 'Socialist', 'Secular', and 'Integrity' to the Preamble.
Fundamental Duties were added to Part IV-A (Article 51A) on the recommendation of the Swaran Singh Committee.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The Constitution of India was adopted on 26th November 1949 and came into force on 26th January 1950.
Dr. B.R. Ambedkar chaired the Drafting Committee responsible for framing the Constitution.
Fundamental Rights are detailed in Part III (Articles 12 to 35) and are legally enforceable.
Directive Principles of State Policy (Part IV) provide guidelines for governance but are non-justiciable.
